benchmark.task: Add AbortSignal support to pLimit options. When the signal aborts, reject queued tasks with signal.reason, reject future submissions immediately, and leave already-running tasks untouched. Update runtime implementation, TypeScript declarations, tests, and README documentation. Preserve existing rejectOnClear behavior and avoid abort-listener leaks.
